lines: Scraping along the far wall, slow and patient.
A laugh drifts down the vent shaft, then stops.
Something breathes on the other side of the drywall.
Tapping on the metal ceiling, three beats, then nothing.
A low hum comes up through the floor grate.
Whispering, too faint to make out any words.
Claws skitter across the tile behind the counter.
The music box in the next room starts up again.
A slow scrape, like a nail dragged down a locker door.
Footsteps stop right outside the storeroom door.
Someone laughs, high and thin, at the end of the hall.
The radar pings twice, then goes quiet again.
Breathing, close and wet, sounds through the air vent.
Knuckles rap against sheet metal, twice, very softly.
A faint hum rises and falls behind the wall panels.
Something drags a heavy thing across the floor above.
A whisper slides under the door and fades out.
Tap, tap, tap, from somewhere inside the ventilation duct.
The carousel creaks once, far off, then falls silent.
Claws scratch the underside of the metal stairs.
A soft laugh, almost friendly, echoes up the stairwell.
Breath fogs the glass of the locker door, then clears.
Humming somewhere below, a tune nobody here knows.
The lights flicker, and something scrapes in the dark.
Wet footsteps circle the room, then go quiet.
A tapping starts on the pipe, matching your heartbeat.
Something clicks in the wall, then a long dry scrape.
A whisper says a name that is not yours.
The relay chatters, and a voice mumbles under the static.
Claws on tile, quick, then they stop dead.
A chuckle rolls through the grille in the ceiling.
Breathing from behind the shelves, slow and deliberate.
Something taps on the window from the outside, twice.
The music box winds down, though nobody touched it.
Scratching at the bottom of the door, patient and steady.
A low drone, like a generator running far away.
Quiet laughter, then a sound like a mouth closing.
Heavy steps on the catwalk, but the catwalk is empty.
A shuffle in the corner where the crates are stacked.
Footsteps behind the wall copy yours, a beat late.
A slow drag of something across the grate below.
Knocking from inside the locker, then a long pause.
Breathing through the vent, in time with your own.
Something hums an old tune, badly, from the next room.
A soft tap on the glass, then a faint giggle.
Scrape, scrape, pause, scrape, from under the stairs.
The air smells of wet fur and hot metal.
Dragging sounds crawl along the ceiling tiles overhead.
Chittering from the ladder shaft, quick and bright.
Breath hitches on the far side of the storeroom door.
A hum rises from the dead relay box, then fades.
Claws click down the stairwell, then go still.
The outage hums, and something moves between the racks.
A single knock lands on the safe room wall.
Heavy breathing drifts in from the corridor past the vent.
A chime from the music box, too slow and too low.
Dry scraping under the floor, moving toward the crates.
Muffled whispering from the storage cage across the hall.
The signal route pings, then a faint voice repeats one word.
Tapping on the duct, getting closer with every beat.
The grate rattles, and a warm breath blows through it.
Something hums to itself in the room next door.
A laugh cuts off mid-breath, somewhere in the ductwork.
Scuffing near the ladder, slow and careful, then nothing.
A creak in the ceiling, then a long wet drag.
The lockers rattle one by one down the row.
Breathing fills the stairwell, far too close to be far.
Something clicks its tongue twice behind the partition.
Static whines, and a soft voice sits under it.
Footsteps pause at the save point, then circle back.
Claws drag across a vent grille, one slow stroke at a time.
The crowbar on the floor shivers, as if something brushed it.
Somewhere a battery hums, then dies with a sigh.
Something scrapes at a lock on the far side of the wall.
A wet snuffle at the bottom of the vent, then quiet.
